name: Support escalation hours policy example
answer:
Urgent account-security escalations are reviewed within 4 hours.
Urgent account-security escalations are reviewed within 48 hours.
Customers can request a weekend escalation for any billing question.

sources.title: Support Escalation Hours Policy
sources.content: Urgent account-security escalations are reviewed within 4 hours. Billing escalations are reviewed during weekday support hours.
